title: fedi-e2ee panics on invalid Ed25519 pubkey
description: ed25519_to_x25519_public() at fedi-e2ee/src/lib.rs:200 calls .expect() on CompressedEdwardsY::decompress(). If the recipient's Ed25519 public key (sourced from a remote actor's DID document) is not a valid curve point, this panics and crashes the server. Attacker can craft a DID document with invalid public key bytes to DoS any server that attempts to encrypt a DM to them. Fix: return E2eeError instead of panicking, propagate through derive_shared_secret and encrypt_dm/decrypt_dm.
close_reason: Fixed: ed25519_to_x25519_public returns Result, .expect() replaced with .ok_or(E2eeError::InvalidPublicKey). Propagated to callers.
